question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

'All at sea'
solution:
The correct answer is: **Confused**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"All at sea"** means to be in a state of confusion or uncertainty about what to do. (उलझन में)

 
 
• **Example: **He felt all at sea when he started his new job because he didn’t know what was expected of him.
 

 
• **Confused** refers to a mental state where a person struggles to understand or make sense of something. (उलझा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **The instructions for the test were so vague that many students were confused about what they had to do.
 
 
• Hence, the meaning of the idiom "All at sea" aligns with the word "Confused".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Confused**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Far away** (दूर): Refers to a physical or metaphorical distance from something.
 
 
• **Example:** The island is far away from the mainland and takes hours to reach by boat.
 
 

 
• **Excited** (उत्साहित): Feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm.
 
 
• **Example:** She was excited to receive her acceptance letter from the university.
 
 

 
• **Drowning** (डूबना): The act of being submerged in water and unable to breathe.
 
 
• **Example:** He saved a child who was drowning in the river.
